title: Hong Kong 100 – Drop bag arrangements
claims: HK100 participants can leave one drop or support bag for CP6 Kei Ling Ha and one for the Finish.
Two drawstring bags of 45 cm by 50 cm are provided during race pack collection.
Only one bag per person is permitted at each of CP6 Kei Ling Ha and the Finish.
Support bags must be dropped with the organisers on the morning of the race at the start.
After a participant passes through CP6, that bag is transported to the Finish.
Runners must collect their drop bags at the finish themselves or through a representative.
Extra luggage beyond the drop bags costs HK$200 per item and is transported directly to the Finish, not to CP6.
